exposure: Number of prior cesarean deliveries (five categories)
cohort: 1840 women who underwent cesarean delivery over an 8-year period at a single service
finding: Increasing number of prior cesarean deliveries was associated with an increased risk of composite adverse maternal outcome, preterm birth, and almost all intraoperative complications except for placental abruption.
mod_finding: An increasing number of prior cesarean deliveries was associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal outcomes, preterm birth, and most intraoperative complications, with a notable increase after the fourth cesarean delivery.
